fusion_candidate.name: IMMUTABLE_EXACT_V15_V16_EXECUTION_GENERATION_FENCE
fusion_candidate.transient_authority: actual live process-local capability derived from currently-held FrankExecutionLease/IngressExecutionLease; durable fields are provenance only
fusion_candidate.storage: immutable effect_id -> exact execution-generation binding, with update/delete denied
fusion_candidate.B1_reservation: EffectAuthorization + live execution capability + confirmation when required -> atomic reservation + immutable generation binding
fusion_candidate.B2_attempt_retry: presented live capability == immutable reservation binding == current V15 presence == exact current V16 execution/admission
fusion_candidate.B3_provider_precommit: recheck the same relation immediately before provider mutation while physical gate remains held
fusion_candidate.turnover_rule: old start/retry authority never transfers; uncertain outcomes default to reconciliation
fusion_candidate.evidence_rule: outcome observation/reconciliation may continue after generation turnover because evidence is not effect authority

hypothesis: A robust Frank effect fence must bind resource-generation and logical execution identity separately: V15 lease_epoch alone is not a complete V16 execution-generation identity.
strongest_counterhypothesis: Because FrankTokenIngressCore maintains one IngressExecutionLease for a held physical/V15 lease, same-epoch V16 execution_id rebinding is unreachable on the production route; binding execution_id would therefore add complexity without causal safety value.

discriminating_experiment.name: SAME_EPOCH_V16_EXECUTION_ID_REBIND
steps: hold one physical FrankExecutionLease and one V15 BUSY epoch
bind V16 context to exec:A and reserve an effect
rebind V16 context to exec:B without releasing the V15/physical lease
derive the candidate fence from the same live lease
attempt to start A-bound effect from B
discriminating_experiment.falsifier: If PR204 is exact-V16 bound, B must be fenced. If B reaches COMMITTING, PR204 aliases execution identities within one V15 generation.
discriminating_experiment.hosted_supplementary_run: workflow job failed before usable test-step telemetry; not mechanism evidence

out_of_box_experiment.reason_for_reuse: Swarm coordination detected PR204 already owns the active GO fence lane and its one unusual reversible experiment; creating CAPABILITY_TAXIDERMY as a second parallel OOB test would be duplicate/noise.
out_of_box_experiment.promotion_rule: Novelty never promotes architecture; result must remain lesionable/reversible and compared to baseline.

external_primary_research.architecture_use: supports keeping idempotency distinct from execution authority and preserving reconciliation after uncertain provider outcomes
